EmailTemplate.description: Used in Email Alert Called " NZC Email Notification Alert for SBTI Updation" which will be used in flow named "NZC Email Notification for SBTI Updation"
EmailTemplate.name: NZC Email Notification Template for SBTI Updation
EmailTemplate.subject: Update SBTI Fields on {!SustainabilityScorecard.Name}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!SustainabilityScorecard.NZC_Supplier_Name__c},
Cognizant has set a goal of achieving Net Zero greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. Over 75% of Cognizant’s emissions are generated through its sourcing of goods and services. Consequently, we are prioritizing the need for suppliers to set emission reduction targets, provide data and keep Cognizant updated on their progress.
We wrote to you to request you to provide your emissions reduction information in Cognizant’s Net Zero Cloud portal and to keep this profile updated, but our records show this has not yet been completed. This is crucial to Cognizant to enable us to calculate and reduce emissions. We therefore strongly encourage you to provide this information promptly.
Thanks, Net Zero Team
